To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
large-scale agile software development in mechatronic organizations can be supported by a set of practices, most of them related to integration, and a set of goals that support agile development.

companies that develop software-intensive mechatronic systems benefit from large-scale agile development practices that focus on regular or continuous integration of deliveries, while the integration cycle is not as important as the frequency of the integration.

the most beneficial integration cycles for deliveries in large-scale mechatronic development are every four weeks, and that continuous integration is not beneficial for all teams, but only for the software teams.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the challenges of implementing agile development in companies with software-intense mecatronics systems, and we present the results of a longitudinal study with a set of goals, practices, and recommendations to help companies to adopt agile principles.
the challenges that companies face when adopting agile development principles in mechatronic companies.
the challenges and practices of large-scale agile software development in the context of software-intense mechanic products.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
large-scale agile development of software-intense mechantronic products is possible, and that the benefits outweigh the challenges.
the goals and practices of agile development in mechatronic companies are different from the goals and practices in companies developing pure software products.
agile development principles are applicable in mechatronics companies and that the key practices to achieve this are the ones that support integration of the different development disciplines.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most successful companies have a high level of integration between the teams, which is enabled by a strong focus on quality.
the agile development principles can be applied to mechatronic systems, and the key enablers to support this are integration, communication, and collaboration.

companies working with software-intensive mechatronic products can benefit from agile principles by adopting a set of practices that enable integration between the software and the other engineering disciplines.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the adoption of agile development principles in mechatronics organizations is feasible and can be achieved through a tailored set of agile practices.
agile principles are applicable to the mechatronic industry, but that the implementation needs to be adapted to the specificities of this industry.
the agile principles can be successfully adopted in companies that develop mechatronic systems, but they need to adapt their agile development practices to the specificities of the domain.
